tonight.headline: McLaurin was limited Thursday and is now questionable — and his fallback locks a day earlier
body: Bad news first: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was limited in Washington's first practice of the week on Thursday (NBC, 15 Oct 22:42 UTC — after yesterday's brief) and ESPN tagged him questionable overnight. He plays Monday night; your only eligible cover is Alvin Kamara, himself limited Wednesday and Thursday with his back, and Kamara's game kicks off Sunday at 11:00. Once it starts he cannot be moved into your lineup, so the McLaurin call has to be made on Washington's Saturday report, not at Monday's inactives.

Everything else holds. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0, against Bok-aneers' 109.5; ESPN 59%. Their side has its own holes: Croskey-Merritt missed Thursday (groin) and Denzel Boston was limited both days (foot).

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: McLaurin 12.4 against Kamara 10.1 is a real gap if McLaurin plays. If Washington rule him out or list him doubtful on Saturday, the only way to field a ninth starter is Kamara into the flex and Coker to WR, before Sunday 11:00.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McLaurin practising fully Friday (Washington's first full-pad day is the tell), or Kamara ruled out — then there is no fallback and McLaurin starts whatever his tag.

case.label: The news
case.body: McLaurin (hamstring) limited Thursday, Washington's first session of a Monday-night week (NBC 15 Oct 22:42Z; 49erswebzone 15 Oct). ESPN added the questionable tag after that; the 12.4 projection did not move.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin kicks off Monday 18:15 CDMX; Kamara Sunday 11:00. A player whose game has started cannot be moved into the lineup, so the lineup tool's Monday 16:45 check is too late. Washington's final report comes Saturday.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Kamara: limited Wednesday and Thursday with the back (Giants.com joint report 15 Oct), 3 carries and 2 catches in Week 5 behind Kendre Miller (archive). Weak, but better than an empty slot. Check he is active at Sun 09:30 CDMX.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is listed doubtful, you start Kamara, and McLaurin plays Monday and outscores him (archive) — or McLaurin is only questionable, stays in, and is inactive at Monday 16:45.
